content.name: Player Builder Autodispatch
content.description: Lets player-owned stations automatically request a construction vessel when a build or reconstruction task is ready, while ensuring that those requests can only be accepted by player-owned builders running Find Build Tasks. NPC construction behaviour is unchanged.
content.author: drjele
